obligation.z: 父母有義務送孩子上學。

oblige.e: Heavy rain may oblige us to cancel the outdoor concert.
oblige.z: 大雨可能會讓我們不得不取消戶外音樂會。

obscure.e: Tall buildings obscure the view of the mountains from my window.
obscure.z: 高樓擋住了我從窗戶望出去的山景。

observation.e: The scientist wrote down every observation in her notebook.
observation.z: 那位科學家把每一項觀察都記在筆記本上。

observe.e: We went to the beach to observe crabs in their natural home.
observe.z: 我們到海邊去觀察螃蟹在自然環境中的樣子。

observer.e: As an observer, she watched the meeting but did not vote.
observer.z: 她以觀察員的身分列席會議，但沒有投票。

obsess.e: Try not to obsess over small mistakes in your drawing.
obsess.z: 別太執著於畫裡的小瑕疵。

obstacle.e: Fear of speaking in public was his biggest obstacle.
obstacle.z: 害怕在眾人面前說話是他最大的障礙。

obstinate.e: The obstinate child refused to wear his raincoat.
obstinate.z: 那個固執的孩子死都不肯穿雨衣。

obtain.e: You can obtain a library card at the front desk.
obtain.z: 你可以在櫃台辦一張借書證。

obvious.e: It was obvious that the little boy was tired.
obvious.z: 很明顯，那個小男孩累了。

occasion.e: She saves her best dress for a special occasion.
occasion.z: 她把最好看的洋裝留到特別的場合才穿。

occasional.e: The weather will be sunny with occasional showers in the afternoon.
occasional.z: 天氣晴朗，下午偶爾會有陣雨。

occupation.e: Please write your parents' occupation on this form.
occupation.z: 請在這張表格上寫下你父母的職業。

occupy.e: Video games occupy most of his free time.
occupy.z: 電玩佔掉了他大部分的空閒時間。

occurrence.e: Earthquakes are a common occurrence in Hualien.
occurrence.z: 在花蓮，地震是常有的事。

octopus.e: An octopus has eight arms and can change its color.
octopus.z: 章魚有八隻腳，而且會變色。

odd.e: It is odd that the store is closed on a Saturday.
odd.z: 那家店星期六居然沒開，真奇怪。

odds.e: The odds of winning the game are low, but we will try our best.
odds.z: 贏得比賽的機會很小，但我們會盡力而為。

odor.e: A strange odor came from the old refrigerator.
odor.z: 那台舊冰箱飄出一股怪味。

offend.e: I did not mean to offend you with my joke.
offend.z: 我開那個玩笑不是故意要冒犯你的。

offense.e: Please take no offense, but your music is too loud.
offense.z: 請別介意，不過你的音樂開得太大聲了。

offensive.e: Some of the comments under the video were offensive.
offensive.z: 影片底下有些留言很冒犯人。

offering.e: The bakery's new offering is a mango cake with cream.
offering.z: 那家麵包店新推出的是一款芒果奶油蛋糕。

offshore.e: Taiwan is building more offshore wind farms near Changhua.
offshore.z: 台灣正在彰化外海興建更多離岸風場。

offspring.e: Most animals take good care of their offspring.
offspring.z: 大部分動物都會好好照顧自己的後代。

okay.e: Is it okay to bring my dog to the café?
okay.z: 可以帶我的狗去這家咖啡店嗎？

olive.e: She added a little olive oil to the salad.
olive.z: 她在沙拉裡加了一點橄欖油。

ongoing.e: The road repair is ongoing, so please drive slowly.
ongoing.z: 道路還在施工中，請放慢速度。

opera.e: My aunt took me to see an opera at the National Theater.
opera.z: 阿姨帶我去國家戲劇院看了一齣歌劇。

operational.e: The new MRT line will be fully operational by next spring.
operational.z: 新的捷運路線預計明年春天全面通車營運。

operative.e: The old law is no longer operative after this year.
operative.z: 那條舊法律今年過後就不再有效了。

operator.e: The phone operator helped me call the hotel.
operator.z: 電話接線生幫我撥電話到飯店。

opponent.e: She shook hands with her opponent after the tennis match.
opponent.z: 網球比賽結束後，她和對手握了手。

oppose.e: Many parents oppose the plan to close the small school.
oppose.z: 很多家長反對關閉那所小學校的計畫。

opposite.e: The bank is on the opposite side of the street.

opposition.e: The plan to build a hotel on the beach met strong opposition from residents.
opposition.z: 在海灘上蓋飯店的計畫遭到居民強烈反對。

oppress.e: In the story, the cruel king continued to oppress the poor farmers.
oppress.z: 在故事裡，殘暴的國王一直壓迫貧苦的農民。

oppression.e: The novel describes the oppression of workers in factories long ago.
oppression.z: 這本小說描寫了很久以前工廠工人所受的壓迫。

opt.e: Many students opt to take the train home on weekends.
opt.z: 很多學生週末選擇搭火車回家。

optimism.e: Her optimism helped the whole team stay calm before the contest.
optimism.z: 她的樂觀幫助整個團隊在比賽前保持冷靜。

optimistic.e: The coach is optimistic about our chances in the final.
optimistic.z: 教練對我們在決賽中的勝算很樂觀。

option.e: Walking is a healthy option for short trips.
option.z: 短程移動的話，走路是個健康的選擇。

optional.e: The extra reading for this class is optional.
optional.z: 這門課的延伸閱讀是自由選讀的。

oral.e: We have an oral test in English class tomorrow.
oral.z: 我們明天英文課有口說測驗。

orbit.e: The moon takes about a month to orbit the earth.
orbit.z: 月球大約要花一個月繞地球運行一圈。

orchard.e: My uncle grows apples in his orchard on the mountain.
orchard.z: 我舅舅在山上的果園種蘋果。

orchestra.e: The school orchestra will play at the graduation ceremony.
orchestra.z: 學校管絃樂團會在畢業典禮上演奏。

ordeal.e: Climbing the mountain in the heavy rain was a real ordeal.
ordeal.z: 冒著大雨爬山真是一場嚴峻的考驗。

orderly.e: The students left the building in an orderly line during the fire drill.
orderly.z: 消防演習時，學生們排好隊伍有秩序地離開大樓。

ordinal numbers.e: First, second, and third are ordinal numbers.
ordinal numbers.z: 第一、第二和第三都是序數。

organ.e: The heart is a very important organ.
organ.z: 心臟是非常重要的器官。

organic.e: This farm grows organic vegetables without chemicals.
organic.z: 這座農場種植不用化學藥劑的有機蔬菜。

organism.e: Every living organism needs water to survive.
organism.z: 每一種生物都需要水才能存活。

organizer.e: The organizer of the fun run thanked all the volunteers.
organizer.z: 路跑活動的主辦人感謝所有志工的幫忙。

orient.e: The first week of school helps new students orient themselves on campus.
orient.z: 開學第一週幫助新生熟悉校園環境。

oriental.e: The shop sells oriental pearls that shine beautifully under the light.
oriental.z: 那家店賣的優質珍珠在燈光下閃閃發亮。

orientation.e: All new students must attend the orientation before school starts.
orientation.z: 所有新生在開學前都必須參加新生訓練。

origin.e: Do you know the origin of the Dragon Boat Festival?
origin.z: 你知道端午節的由來嗎？

original.e: The original plan was to go hiking, but it rained.
original.z: 原本的計畫是去爬山，結果下雨了。

originality.e: The judges praised the originality of her short film.
originality.z: 評審稱讚她的短片很有獨創性。

originate.e: Many popular bubble tea shops originate in Taichung.
originate.z: 許多受歡迎的珍奶店都發源於台中。

ornament.e: The children used paper stars to ornament the classroom for the holiday.
ornament.z: 孩子們用紙星星裝飾教室來迎接節日。

orphan.e: The story is about a brave orphan who finds a new family.
orphan.z: 這個故事在講一個勇敢的孤兒找到新家庭的經過。

orphanage.e: Our class visited an orphanage and played games with the kids.
orphanage.z: 我們班去參訪一間孤兒院，還和院裡的孩子一起玩遊戲。

orthodox.e: The coach used an orthodox training method that has worked for years.
orthodox.z: 教練採用一套行之多年的傳統訓練方法。

otherwise.e: Hurry up, otherwise we will miss the bus.
otherwise.z: 快一點，不然我們會趕不上公車。

ounce.e: This recipe needs one ounce of butter.
ounce.z: 這道食譜需要一盎司的奶油。

outbreak.e: The school closed for a week after the outbreak of flu.
outbreak.z: 流感爆發後，學校停課了一個星期。

outcome.e: Nobody could guess the outcome of the game.
outcome.z: 沒有人猜得到比賽的結果。

outdoor.e: The outdoor concert was canceled because of the typhoon.
outdoor.z: 戶外音樂會因為颱風取消了。

outdoors.e: The kids love to play outdoors after school.
outdoors.z: 孩子們放學後很喜歡在戶外玩。

outer.e: Remove the outer leaves of the cabbage before you cook it.
outer.z: 煮高麗菜之前，先把外面的葉子剝掉。

outfit.e: The school will outfit every classroom with new projectors.
outfit.z: 學校將為每間教室配備新的投影機。

outgoing.e: Lily is outgoing and makes friends easily.
outgoing.z: 莉莉個性外向，很容易交到朋友。

outing.e: The family went on a weekend outing to the countryside.
outing.z: 那一家人週末到鄉下郊遊。

outlaw.e: Some cities outlaw smoking in all public parks.
outlaw.z: 有些城市禁止在所有公園內抽菸。

outlet.e: Is there a power outlet near your seat?
outlet.z: 你的座位附近有插座嗎？

outline.e: Write an outline before you start your essay.
outline.z: 開始寫作文前，先寫一份大綱。

outlook.e: Her positive outlook on life inspires everyone around her.
outlook.z: 她對人生的正面看法激勵了身邊的每一個人。

outnumber.e: In our class, girls outnumber boys by five.
outnumber.z: 在我們班上，女生比男生多五個人。

output.e: The factory doubled its output of electric scooters this year.
output.z: 那間工廠今年的電動機車產量增加了一倍。

outrage.e: The plan to cut down the old trees caused outrage among local people.
outrage.z: 砍掉那些老樹的計畫引起了當地居民的憤慨。

outrageous.e: The price of the hotel room was outrageous during the holiday.
outrageous.z: 連假期間那間飯店的房價貴得離譜。

outright.e: She gave an outright refusal when he asked to copy her homework.
outright.z: 他要抄她的作業時，她直截了當地拒絕了。

outset.e: The teacher made the rules clear at the outset of the semester.
outset.z: 老師在學期一開始就把規則講清楚了。

outsider.e: As a new student, he felt like an outsider at first.
outsider.z: 身為轉學生，他一開始覺得自己像個局外人。

outskirts.e: They live on the outskirts of the city, near the rice fields.
outskirts.z: 他們住在市郊，靠近稻田的地方。

outstanding.e: She received an award for her outstanding work in science.
outstanding.z: 她因為在科學方面的傑出表現而得獎。

outward.e: The outward part of the shell is rough, but the inside is smooth.
outward.z: 貝殼外面摸起來很粗糙，裡面卻很光滑。

outwards.e: The door opens outwards, so please step back.
outwards.z: 這扇門是往外開的，請往後退一點。

oval.e: The dining table in our new house is oval.
oval.z: 我們新家的餐桌是橢圓形的。

overall.e: The overall cost of the trip was lower than we expected.
overall.z: 這趟旅行的總花費比我們預期的還要低。

overcoat.e: Grandpa wears a heavy overcoat when he walks on cold mornings.
overcoat.z: 寒冷的早晨，爺爺出門散步都會穿上厚重的大衣。

overcome.e: With practice, she was able to overcome her fear of water.
overcome.z: 經過練習，她終於克服了怕水的恐懼。

overdo.e: Exercise is good, but don't overdo it on the first day.
overdo.z: 運動很好，但第一天不要做得太過頭。

overflow.e: Turn off the tap, or the bathtub will overflow.
overflow.z: 把水龍頭關掉，不然浴缸的水會滿出來。

overhead.e: Please put your bags in the overhead bins.
overhead.z: 請把您的包包放進頭頂上方的置物櫃。

overhear.e: I didn't mean to overhear your phone call.
overhear.z: 我不是故意要聽到你講電話的。

overlap.e: The two classes overlap on Tuesday afternoons, so I can only take one.
overlap.z: 這兩門課在星期二下午時間重疊，所以我只能選一門。

overlook.e: The rooms on the top floor overlook the ocean.
overlook.z: 頂樓的房間可以俯瞰大海。

overnight.e: The cookies became famous overnight after a popular video.
overnight.z: 一支爆紅的影片讓這款餅乾一夜之間出了名。

oversee.e: Two teachers will oversee the students during the field trip.
oversee.z: 校外教學期間會有兩位老師負責監督學生。

overtake.e: The runner tried to overtake the leader near the finish line.
overtake.z: 那位跑者在終點線附近試圖超越領先的人。

overthrow.e: The people tried to overthrow the cruel king long ago.
overthrow.z: 很久以前，人民試圖推翻那位殘暴的國王。

overturn.e: A strong wave can overturn a small boat in seconds.
overturn.z: 一道大浪幾秒內就能把小船打翻。

overwhelm.e: Too much homework can overwhelm students before final exams.
overwhelm.z: 期末考前，太多作業會讓學生喘不過氣。

overwork.e: Doctors warn that people who overwork may get sick more easily.
overwork.z: 醫生提醒，工作過度的人比較容易生病。

owe.e: I still owe my sister fifty dollars for lunch.
owe.z: 我還欠我姊姊五十元的午餐錢。

owl.e: An owl sat quietly in the tree all night.
owl.z: 一隻貓頭鷹整晚靜靜地停在樹上。

ownership.e: The ownership of the old house passed to his son.
ownership.z: 那棟老房子的所有權轉給了他的兒子。

oxygen.e: Plants give off oxygen during the day.
oxygen.z: 植物在白天會釋放氧氣。

oyster.e: We ordered fried oyster at the night market in Tainan.
oyster.z: 我們在臺南夜市點了炸牡蠣。

ozone.e: The ozone layer protects the earth from strong sunlight.
ozone.z: 臭氧層保護地球不受強烈陽光傷害。

pace.e: Our teacher asked us to read at a slower pace.
pace.z: 老師要我們放慢閱讀的速度。

pacific ocean.e: Hualien faces the Pacific Ocean on its eastern side.

packet.e: She opened a packet of sugar for her coffee.
packet.z: 她撕開一小包糖加進咖啡裡。

pad.e: Please wear a knee pad when you go skating.

paddle.e: We learned to paddle a canoe on the quiet lake.
paddle.z: 我們在平靜的湖上學划獨木舟。

pal.e: Tom has been my pal since elementary school.
pal.z: 湯姆從國小起就是我的好朋友。

palace.e: Tourists waited in line to visit the royal palace.

palm.e: The little bird sat in the palm of her hand.
palm.z: 那隻小鳥停在她的手掌心。

pancake.e: Mom made a big pancake with honey for breakfast.
pancake.z: 媽媽早餐做了一大片淋上蜂蜜的鬆餅。

panel.e: A panel of teachers will judge the speech contest.
panel.z: 演講比賽將由一組老師擔任評審。

panic.e: Don't panic if the lights go out during the storm.
panic.z: 暴風雨中如果停電，不要驚慌。

paperback.e: I bought a cheap paperback to read on the train.
paperback.z: 我買了一本便宜的平裝書在火車上看。

parachute.e: The soldier opened his parachute high above the field.
parachute.z: 那名士兵在田野高空打開了降落傘。

parade.e: Thousands of people watched the parade on New Year's Day.
parade.z: 元旦那天有好幾千人觀看遊行。

paradise.e: This quiet beach is a paradise for surfers.
paradise.z: 這片寧靜的海灘是衝浪客的天堂。

paradox.e: It is a paradox that the busiest people often have the most free time.
paradox.z: 最忙的人往往最有空，這是個矛盾的說法。

paragraph.e: Please read the first paragraph out loud.

parallel.e: The bike path runs parallel to the river.
parallel.z: 這條自行車道和河流平行。

paralyze.e: A heavy snowstorm can paralyze traffic in the whole city.
paralyze.z: 一場大雪可能讓整座城市的交通癱瘓。

parcel.e: A parcel from my aunt arrived this morning.
parcel.z: 阿姨寄來的包裹今天早上到了。

parliament.e: The new law was passed by parliament last week.
parliament.z: 新法律上週由議會通過。

partial.e: The report gives only a partial picture of the problem.
partial.z: 這份報告只呈現了問題的一部分。

participant.e: Each participant will receive a free T-shirt.
participant.z: 每位參加者都會拿到一件免費的上衣。

participate.e: All students can participate in the school sports day.
participate.z: 所有學生都可以參加學校運動會。

participation.e: Your participation in class discussion is part of your grade.
participation.z: 上課參與討論的情形也算在成績裡。

particle.e: A tiny particle of dust got into my eye.
particle.z: 一顆小小的灰塵跑進我的眼睛。

partly.e: The road was partly closed because of the rain.
partly.z: 因為下雨，那條路封閉了一部分。

partnership.e: The two schools started a partnership to share books.
partnership.z: 兩所學校建立合作關係，互相分享書籍。

parts of speech.e: Nouns and verbs are two common parts of speech.
parts of speech.z: 名詞和動詞是兩種常見的詞性。

passage.e: A narrow passage leads to the back garden.
passage.z: 一條窄窄的通道通往後院。

passion.e: Her passion for music started when she was six.
passion.z: 她對音樂的熱情從六歲就開始了。

passionate.e: Mr. Lin is a passionate teacher who loves his students.
passionate.z: 林老師是一位熱情、很愛學生的老師。

passive.e: Don't be passive in class, and ask questions when you're confused.
passive.z: 上課別太被動，有疑問就發問。

passport.e: Remember to bring your passport to the airport.

password.z: 千萬別把密碼告訴任何人。

pastime.e: Fishing is my grandfather's favorite pastime on weekends.
pastime.z: 釣魚是爺爺週末最喜歡的消遣。

pastry.e: The bakery sells a sweet pastry filled with cream.
pastry.z: 那家麵包店賣一種包著奶油的甜酥皮點心。

pat.e: The coach likes to pat players on the back after a good game.
pat.z: 比賽打得好時，教練喜歡輕拍球員的背。

patch.e: Grandma sewed a patch on the hole in my jeans.
patch.z: 奶奶在我牛仔褲的破洞上縫了一塊補丁。

patent.e: The young inventor hopes to patent her new design.
patent.z: 那位年輕發明家希望替她的新設計申請專利。

pathetic.e: The lost puppy looked pathetic in the cold rain.
pathetic.z: 那隻走失的小狗在冷雨中看起來好可憐。

patience.e: Learning a new language takes a lot of patience.
patience.z: 學一種新語言需要很多耐心。

patriot.e: The old soldier was remembered as a true patriot.
patriot.z: 那位老兵被人們記得是一位真正的愛國者。

patriotic.e: Everyone sang patriotic songs at the National Day celebration.
patriotic.z: 大家在國慶活動上唱愛國歌曲。

patrol.e: Police officers patrol the park every night.
patrol.z: 警察每晚都會在公園巡邏。

patron.e: He has been a loyal patron of this noodle shop for years.
patron.z: 他多年來一直是這家麵店的老主顧。

pave.e: The town plans to pave the dirt road next year.
pave.z: 鎮上計畫明年把那條泥土路鋪好。

pavement.e: Children drew pictures on the pavement with chalk.
pavement.z: 孩子們用粉筆在人行道上畫畫。

paw.e: The cat licked its paw after eating.
paw.z: 那隻貓吃完東西後舔了舔牠的爪子。

payment.e: You can make a payment by card.

pea.e: My little brother picked every pea out of his rice.
pea.z: 我弟弟把飯裡的每顆豌豆都挑了出來。

peacock.e: A peacock spread its beautiful tail at the zoo.
peacock.z: 動物園裡有一隻孔雀展開了美麗的尾巴。

peak.e: We reached the peak of the mountain at sunrise.
peak.z: 我們在日出時登上山頂。

peanut.e: He is sick if he eats even one peanut.

balloonist.e: The balloonist rose slowly above the green fields.
balloonist.z: 熱氣球駕駛員緩緩升到綠色田野的上空。

balmy.e: We enjoyed a balmy evening walk by the sea.
balmy.z: 我們在海邊享受了一段溫暖舒適的傍晚散步。

cuban.e: The Cuban in our tour group taught us a few dance steps.
cuban.z: 我們旅行團裡的那位古巴人教了我們幾個舞步。

bandleader.e: The bandleader raised his hand, and the music began.
bandleader.z: 樂隊指揮舉起手，音樂隨即響起。

bandmaster.e: The school bandmaster asks us to practice every morning.
bandmaster.z: 學校樂隊指揮要求我們每天早上練習。

bandanna.e: He wore a red bandanna around his neck on the hike.
bandanna.z: 他健行時在脖子上綁了一條紅色大方巾。

barb.e: The fishhook has a sharp barb that keeps the fish from escaping.
barb.z: 魚鉤上有尖銳的倒鉤，讓魚逃不掉。

barbed wire.e: The farm is surrounded by barbed wire to keep the cows inside.
barbed wire.z: 農場四周圍著帶刺鐵絲網，防止牛跑出去。

barge.e: A long barge carried coal slowly down the river.
barge.z: 一艘長長的駁船載著煤，緩緩順河而下。

baroque.e: The old theater has a baroque ceiling covered in gold.
baroque.z: 這間老劇院的天花板裝飾繁複，滿是金色雕飾。

barrenness.e: The barrenness of the desert surprised the travelers.
barrenness.z: 沙漠的荒涼讓旅客們很吃驚。

barter.e: In the past, people would barter rice for salt.
barter.z: 從前人們會用米來交換鹽。

be taken by.e: Visitors will surely be taken by the beauty of Taroko Gorge.
be taken by.z: 遊客們一定會被太魯閣峽谷的美景迷住。

be up to.e: It will be up to you to choose the restaurant.
be up to.z: 要去哪家餐廳就由你來決定。

beaded.e: She carried a beaded bag to the party.
beaded.z: 她帶著一個串珠裝飾的包包去參加派對。

beak.e: The bird used its beak to crack the seed.
beak.z: 那隻鳥用嘴喙啄開種子。

girder.e: Workers lifted a steel girder onto the new bridge.
girder.z: 工人把一根鋼梁吊到新橋上。

unbearable.e: The summer heat in the classroom was almost unbearable.
unbearable.z: 夏天教室裡的悶熱幾乎讓人受不了。

forebear.e: Our forebear came to Taiwan by boat about two hundred years ago.
forebear.z: 我們的祖先大約兩百年前搭船來到臺灣。

bedrock.e: Trust is the bedrock of a good friendship.
bedrock.z: 信任是良好友誼的基石。

belie.e: Her soft voice may belie her strong will.
belie.z: 她說話輕聲細語，容易讓人看不出她意志堅強。

believe in.e: Our coach taught us to believe in ourselves.
believe in.z: 我們的教練教我們要相信自己。

bellows.e: The blacksmith used bellows to make the fire hotter.
bellows.z: 鐵匠用風箱讓爐火燒得更旺。

belong to.e: Does this blue umbrella belong to you?
belong to.z: 這把藍色的傘是你的嗎？

bequest.e: The library received a large bequest from a former teacher.
bequest.z: 圖書館收到一位老教師留下的一大筆遺贈。

besiege.e: Every summer, tourists besiege the small beach town.
besiege.z: 每到夏天，遊客就把這座海邊小鎮擠得水洩不通。

bestow.e: The school will bestow an award on the best volunteer.
bestow.z: 學校將頒獎給表現最好的志工。

bicameral.e: The country has a bicameral legislature with two houses.
bicameral.z: 這個國家實行兩院制，國會分成兩個議院。

hillbilly.e: In the old movie, a hillbilly comes to the big city.
hillbilly.z: 那部老電影裡，一個山裡來的鄉下人來到了大城市。

biographer.e: The biographer spent ten years writing about the scientist's life.
biographer.z: 這位傳記作家花了十年撰寫那位科學家的一生。

biologist.e: A biologist came to our class to talk about frogs.
biologist.z: 一位生物學家來我們班上介紹青蛙。

biological diversity.e: Rain forests are very rich in biological diversity.
biological diversity.z: 雨林擁有非常豐富的生物多樣性。

bison.e: Huge herds of bison once lived on the American plains.
bison.z: 從前美洲平原上住著一大群一大群的野牛。

bitterness.e: The bitterness of the coffee made me add some sugar.
bitterness.z: 咖啡太苦了，我加了一點糖。

blast furnace.e: Iron ore is melted in a blast furnace at the steel plant.
blast furnace.z: 鐵礦石在鋼鐵廠的高爐裡熔化。

bleachers.e: Parents sat in the bleachers to watch the baseball game.
bleachers.z: 家長們坐在露天看臺上看棒球賽。

blizzard.e: The blizzard closed all the roads for two days.
blizzard.z: 暴風雪讓所有道路封閉了兩天。

blues.e: He always gets the blues on rainy Sunday nights.
blues.z: 每到下雨的週日晚上，他總是心情低落。

bluff.e: We stood on a high bluff and looked down at the sea.
bluff.z: 我們站在高高的懸崖上俯瞰大海。

boarder.e: The family takes in a boarder to help pay the rent.
boarder.z: 這家人收了一位寄宿者來分擔房租。

boardinghouse.e: As a student, he lived in a small boardinghouse near the station.
boardinghouse.z: 他學生時代住在車站附近的一間小寄宿公寓。

boastful.e: Nobody likes a boastful player who never praises his team.
boastful.z: 沒有人喜歡愛吹噓、從不稱讚隊友的球員。

boiling point.e: The boiling point of water is 100 degrees Celsius.
boiling point.z: 水的沸點是攝氏一百度。

bolster.e: Good grades can bolster your confidence.
bolster.z: 好成績能增強你的信心。

bonanza.e: The long rainy season was a bonanza for umbrella sellers.
bonanza.z: 漫長的雨季對賣傘的人來說是一大商機。

baby boom.e: Many schools were built during the baby boom after the war.
baby boom.z: 戰後嬰兒潮期間蓋了許多學校。

boon.e: The new bus line is a boon to students living far away.
boon.z: 新公車路線對住得遠的學生來說是一大福音。

baboon.e: A baboon at the zoo stole a visitor's hat.
baboon.z: 動物園裡一隻狒狒搶走了遊客的帽子。

boulder.e: A huge boulder fell onto the road after the heavy rain.
boulder.z: 大雨過後，一塊巨石掉到了路上。

boundless.e: Young children seem to have boundless energy.
boundless.z: 小孩子似乎有用不完的精力。

bouquet.e: He gave his mother a bouquet of roses on her birthday.
bouquet.z: 他在媽媽生日那天送她一束玫瑰。

bowlegged.e: The old cowboy walked with a bowlegged step.
bowlegged.z: 那位老牛仔走起路來兩腿向外彎。

braid.e: My sister can braid her hair in two minutes.
braid.z: 我妹妹兩分鐘就能把頭髮編成辮子。

brawl.e: The two neighbors had a loud brawl over the parking space.
brawl.z: 兩個鄰居為了停車位大吵一架。

brawling.e: The teacher warned that brawling in the hallway is not allowed.
brawling.z: 老師警告說，不准在走廊上吵吵鬧鬧。

break apart.e: The old boat began to break apart in the storm.
break apart.z: 那艘舊船在暴風雨中開始解體。

break all ties with.e: She decided to break all ties with the company after it lied to her.
break all ties with.z: 那家公司欺騙她之後，她決定和它斷絕一切往來。

break out.e: A fire may break out if you leave the stove on.
break out.z: 如果你沒關爐火，可能會發生火災。

break up.e: The ice on the lake will break up in spring.
break up.z: 湖上的冰到了春天就會裂開。

breathing.e: Deep breathing can help you relax before a test.
breathing.z: 考試前深呼吸可以幫助你放鬆。

crossbreeding.e: Crossbreeding produced a new kind of rice that grows faster.
crossbreeding.z: 雜交育種培育出一種長得更快的新稻米。

brilliance.e: Everyone admired the brilliance of her idea.
brilliance.z: 大家都佩服她這個點子的高明。

brilliantly.e: The stars shone brilliantly in the clear night sky.
brilliantly.z: 星星在晴朗的夜空中燦爛閃耀。

brim.e: She filled the cup to the brim with hot tea.
brim.z: 她把熱茶倒進杯子，一直滿到杯緣。

broad-brimmed.e: The farmer wore a broad-brimmed hat under the hot sun.
broad-brimmed.z: 農夫在烈日下戴著一頂寬邊帽。

briny.e: The briny smell of the sea filled the air.
briny.z: 空氣中瀰漫著大海鹹鹹的味道。

briskness.e: She walked with a briskness that surprised us all.
briskness.z: 她走路輕快俐落，讓我們都很驚訝。

sun-bronzed.e: The sun-bronzed fishermen returned with a big catch.
sun-bronzed.z: 曬成古銅色的漁夫們滿載而歸。

brownish.e: The river water looked brownish after the typhoon.
brownish.z: 颱風過後，河水看起來呈褐色。

buddy.e: Tom has been my buddy since elementary school.
buddy.z: 湯姆從國小起就是我的好朋友。

buggy.e: The family rode in a horse buggy through the old town.
buggy.z: 那一家人坐著小馬車遊覽老城區。

building block.e: My little brother built a tall tower with a building block set.
building block.z: 我弟弟用一組積木蓋了一座高塔。

burdensome.e: The heavy homework load became burdensome for the students.
burdensome.z: 沉重的作業量成了學生的負擔。

burgeon.e: Small cafes began to burgeon along the river.
burgeon.z: 河邊的小咖啡館開始如雨後春筍般冒出來。

burning.e: The burning of plastic produces harmful smoke.
burning.z: 燃燒塑膠會產生有害的煙。

burrow.e: Rabbits burrow under the ground to stay safe.
burrow.z: 兔子在地底挖洞來保護自己。

bust.e: A bronze bust of the school founder stands in the hall.
bust.z: 學校創辦人的銅製半身像立在大廳裡。

combustion.e: Combustion needs fuel, heat, and oxygen.
combustion.z: 燃燒需要燃料、熱和氧氣。

combustible.e: Keep combustible materials away from the kitchen stove.
combustible.z: 易燃物品要遠離廚房的爐子。

bustle.e: I love the bustle of the night market on weekends.
bustle.z: 我喜歡週末夜市熱鬧忙碌的氣氛。

buzzer.e: Press the buzzer when you know the answer.
buzzer.z: 知道答案時就按下搶答鈴。

by a factor of.e: The number of visitors increased by a factor of three this year.
by a factor of.z: 今年的遊客人數增加為原來的三倍。

by chance.e: I met my old teacher by chance at the train station.
by chance.z: 我在火車站碰巧遇到以前的老師。

by far.e: This is by far the best pizza in town.
by far.z: 這絕對是鎮上最好吃的披薩，其他家都比不上。

by-product.e: Sawdust is a by-product of making furniture.
by-product.z: 木屑是製作家具的副產品。

the cabinet.e: The cabinet will meet on Monday to discuss the budget.
the cabinet.z: 內閣將在星期一開會討論預算。

cabinetmaker.e: The cabinetmaker built a beautiful desk from old wood.
cabinetmaker.z: 這位家具師傅用舊木頭做了一張漂亮的書桌。

log cabin.e: We spent the weekend in a log cabin in the mountains.
log cabin.z: 我們週末住在山上的一間小木屋。

cacti.e: Many cacti grow in the dry desert.
cacti.z: 乾燥的沙漠裡長著許多仙人掌。

cadence.e: The poem has a gentle cadence when read aloud.
cadence.z: 這首詩唸出來有一種柔和的抑揚頓挫。

calibration.e: The scale needs calibration before we weigh the samples.
calibration.z: 秤樣本之前，這臺秤需要先校準。

cannibalism.e: Cannibalism is common among some kinds of spiders.
cannibalism.z: 同類相食在某些蜘蛛中很常見。

canopy.e: The tall trees form a thick canopy over the trail.
canopy.z: 高大的樹木在步道上方形成濃密的遮蔭。

carapace.e: The turtle hid its head inside its hard carapace.
carapace.z: 烏龜把頭縮進堅硬的甲殼裡。

carat.e: The ring has a small one-carat diamond.
carat.z: 這枚戒指鑲著一顆一克拉的小鑽石。

carbohydrate.e: Rice is a good source of carbohydrate.
carbohydrate.z: 米飯是碳水化合物的好來源。

cardiac.e: The hospital opened a new cardiac center last month.
cardiac.z: 醫院上個月成立了新的心臟醫學中心。

careerism.e: His careerism made him work late every night.
careerism.z: 他一心追求升遷，每晚都工作到很晚。

carelessly.e: He carelessly left his phone on the bus.
carelessly.z: 他粗心地把手機忘在公車上。

caricature.e: The artist drew a funny caricature of our teacher.
caricature.z: 那位畫家幫我們老師畫了一張誇張又好笑的漫畫像。

carnivorous.e: Lions are carnivorous animals that hunt for food.
carnivorous.z: 獅子是靠獵捕維生的肉食動物。

carver.e: The wood carver made a small bird for my sister.
carver.z: 那位木雕師傅幫我妹妹刻了一隻小鳥。

carving.e: There is a stone carving of a dragon above the door.
carving.z: 門上方有一座龍的石雕。

casting.e: The bell was made by casting hot metal into a mold.
casting.z: 這口鐘是把熔化的金屬倒進模具鑄造而成的。

cast-iron.e: My grandmother cooks eggs in a heavy cast-iron pan.
cast-iron.z: 我奶奶用一個很重的鑄鐵鍋煎蛋。

cast off.e: It is time to cast off old habits and start again.
cast off.z: 是時候拋開舊習慣，重新開始了。

cast away.e: The sailors feared the storm would cast away their ship.
cast away.z: 水手們擔心暴風雨會讓船隻失事漂流。

rebroadcast.e: The TV station will rebroadcast the concert on Sunday.
rebroadcast.z: 電視臺將在星期天重播這場演唱會。

newscast.e: My parents watch the evening newscast at seven.
newscast.z: 我爸媽每天七點看晚間新聞。

overcast.e: The sky was overcast, so we took umbrellas.
overcast.z: 天空陰陰的，所以我們帶了傘。

catalyst.e: The new coach was a catalyst for the team's success.
catalyst.z: 新教練是這支球隊成功的推手。

catalyze.e: Good teachers can catalyze a love of learning in students.
catalyze.z: 好老師能激發學生對學習的熱愛。

catching.e: Her laughter is so catching that everyone starts to smile.
catching.z: 她的笑聲很有感染力，大家都跟著笑了起來。

eye-catching.e: The shop has an eye-catching sign in bright red.
eye-catching.z: 那家店有一個鮮紅色、很吸睛的招牌。

catch on.e: He is new here, but he will catch on quickly.
catch on.z: 他剛來這裡，不過很快就會進入狀況。

cautiously.e: The cat walked cautiously toward the strange box.
cautiously.z: 貓小心翼翼地走向那個奇怪的箱子。

cavern.e: We used flashlights to explore the dark cavern.
cavern.z: 我們用手電筒探索那個黑暗的大洞穴。

ceaseless.e: The ceaseless rain caused flooding in the town.
ceaseless.z: 下個不停的雨讓小鎮淹水了。

celebrated.e: A celebrated chef will teach a cooking class at our school.
celebrated.z: 一位知名主廚將到我們學校教烹飪課。

celestial.e: The moon is the closest celestial body to the earth.
celestial.z: 月球是離地球最近的天體。

cellist.e: The cellist played a slow and beautiful song.
cellist.z: 那位大提琴家演奏了一首緩慢優美的曲子。

cello.e: My cousin has played the cello for six years.
cello.z: 我表妹拉大提琴已經六年了。

centennial.e: Our school will celebrate its centennial next year.
centennial.z: 我們學校明年將慶祝創校一百週年。

centigrade.e: The temperature today is 30 degrees centigrade.
centigrade.z: 今天氣溫是攝氏三十度。

ceremonial.e: The mayor cut the ribbon with a pair of ceremonial scissors.
ceremonial.z: 市長用一把典禮專用的剪刀剪綵。

chafe.e: New shoes often chafe the back of my heels.
chafe.z: 新鞋常常會磨破我的腳後跟。

chagrin.e: To my chagrin, the store had sold out of the book.
chagrin.z: 令我懊惱的是，那本書已經賣完了。

chaotic.e: The traffic was chaotic after the power went out.

be characterized by.e: This area can be characterized by hot, wet summers.
be characterized by.z: 這個地區的特色是夏天炎熱又潮濕。

charcoal.e: We grilled corn over charcoal on Moon Festival night.
charcoal.z: 中秋節晚上我們用木炭烤玉米。

charter.e: The school will charter a bus for the field trip.
charter.z: 學校會包一輛遊覽車去校外教學。

chaste.e: She writes in a chaste and simple style.

chateau.e: We stayed one night in an old chateau in France.
chateau.z: 我們在法國一座古老的城堡住了一晚。

checkout.e: There was a long line at the checkout in the supermarket.
checkout.z: 超市的結帳櫃檯大排長龍。

check out.e: The mechanic will check out the engine tomorrow.

paycheck.e: She saves part of her paycheck every month.
paycheck.z: 她每個月都會存下一部分薪水。

chilli.e: Be careful, this chilli is very hot.

chisel.e: He learned to chisel letters into stone.

chivalry.e: Holding the door for others is a small act of chivalry.
chivalry.z: 幫別人扶門是一種小小的紳士風度。

choppy.e: The sea was too choppy for the small boat.
choppy.z: 海面波濤起伏，小船沒辦法出海。

choreography.e: The choreography of the school dance show was amazing.
choreography.z: 學校舞蹈表演的編舞非常精彩。

choreograph.e: Our dance teacher will choreograph a new routine for the contest.
choreograph.z: 我們的舞蹈老師會為比賽編一支新舞。

choreographer.e: The choreographer showed the dancers each step slowly.
choreographer.z: 編舞老師慢慢地示範每一個舞步給舞者看。

choreographic.e: She has great choreographic talent for someone so young.
choreographic.z: 她年紀輕輕就很有編舞的天分。

chronological.e: Please put the photos in chronological order.
chronological.z: 請把照片按照時間先後排好。

chronology.e: The museum shows a chronology of Taiwan's railway history.
chronology.z: 博物館展示了臺灣鐵路發展的年表。

cider.e: We drank cold apple cider at the picnic.
cider.z: 我們在野餐時喝冰涼的蘋果汁。

cipher.e: The children made a secret cipher to write notes to each other.
cipher.z: 孩子們發明了一套秘密密碼來互傳紙條。

circumference.e: We measured the circumference of the tree with a rope.
circumference.z: 我們用繩子量了那棵樹的周長。

circumscribe.e: School rules circumscribe the use of phones in class.
circumscribe.z: 校規限制上課時使用手機。

citadel.e: The old citadel stands on a hill above the city.
citadel.z: 那座古老的要塞矗立在城市上方的山丘上。

civil rights.e: The class read a book about the history of civil rights.
civil rights.z: 全班讀了一本關於民權發展歷史的書。

civil war.e: Our history teacher explained why the American Civil War began.
civil war.z: 歷史老師解釋了美國南北戰爭爆發的原因。

civility.e: Please treat your classmates with civility, even when you disagree.
civility.z: 即使意見不同，也請以禮對待同學。

clamor.e: The clamor of the crowd made it hard to hear.
clamor.z: 群眾的喧鬧聲讓人很難聽清楚。

reclamation.e: Land reclamation turned the old marsh into farmland.
reclamation.z: 土地開墾把舊沼澤變成了農田。

clan.e: The whole clan gathers at Grandpa's house every Lunar New Year.
clan.z: 每逢農曆新年，整個家族都會聚在爺爺家。

clarification.e: I emailed the teacher for clarification about the homework.
clarification.z: 我寄電子郵件請老師說明作業的細節。

clergy.e: Members of the clergy visited the hospital to comfort patients.

northwest.z: 那個村莊位於島的西北方。

nylon.e: This light jacket is made of nylon.
nylon.z: 這件輕薄的外套是尼龍做的。

olympic.e: She dreams of winning an Olympic gold medal one day.
olympic.z: 她夢想有一天能贏得奧運金牌。

one-sided.e: The final game was one-sided, and we lost badly.
one-sided.z: 決賽一面倒，我們輸得很慘。

opener.e: Can you pass me the can opener, please?
opener.z: 可以請你把開罐器遞給我嗎？

opening.e: The opening scene of the movie was very exciting.
opening.z: 電影的開場畫面非常精彩。

overweight.e: The vet said my cat is a little overweight.
overweight.z: 獸醫說我的貓有點過重。

pacific.e: We watched the sunrise over the Pacific from Hualien.
pacific.z: 我們在花蓮看太平洋上的日出。

participle.e: Our teacher explained how to use a participle in a sentence.
participle.z: 老師解釋了怎麼在句子裡使用分詞。

petal.e: A pink petal fell from the cherry tree onto my book.
petal.z: 一片粉紅色的花瓣從櫻花樹上落到我的書上。

postal.e: The postal service is closed on national holidays.
postal.z: 郵政服務在國定假日暫停。

powerless.e: We felt powerless as the typhoon destroyed the crops.
powerless.z: 看著颱風摧毀農作物，我們感到無能為力。

preferable.e: Walking to school is preferable to taking a crowded bus.
preferable.z: 走路上學比搭擁擠的公車好。

presently.e: The manager is presently on a business trip in Japan.
presently.z: 經理目前正在日本出差。

qualified.e: She is well qualified to teach music.

readily.e: He readily agreed to help us with the project.
readily.z: 他爽快地答應幫我們做這個專題。

reading.e: Reading before bed helps me sleep better.
reading.z: 睡前閱讀讓我睡得更好。

related.e: The teacher gave us some questions related to the story.
related.z: 老師給了我們一些和這個故事相關的問題。

relatively.e: The test was relatively easy this time.

repeatedly.e: The baby repeatedly dropped his spoon on the floor.
repeatedly.z: 小寶寶一再把湯匙丟到地上。

restless.e: The children grew restless during the long speech.
restless.z: 冗長的演講讓孩子們越來越坐不住。

reunite.e: The two old friends hope to reunite next summer.
reunite.z: 這兩位老朋友希望明年夏天能重逢。

rewrite.e: The teacher asked me to rewrite my essay.

rider.e: The rider wore a helmet and bright clothes.
rider.z: 那位騎士戴著安全帽，穿著顏色鮮豔的衣服。

running.e: It has rained for five days running.
running.z: 已經連續下了五天的雨。

sanction.e: The school refused to sanction the late-night party.
sanction.z: 學校拒絕批准那場深夜派對。

saying.e: My grandmother has a saying for every situation.
saying.z: 我奶奶遇到什麼事，都有一句老話可以說。

schoolmate.e: I met an old schoolmate at the bookstore today.
schoolmate.z: 我今天在書店遇到一位以前的同學。

seaside.e: We spent our summer vacation at the seaside.

second-hand.e: He bought a second-hand bike for his trip around Taiwan.
second-hand.z: 他為了環島買了一輛二手腳踏車。

shining.e: The shining stars filled the night sky.
shining.z: 閃亮的星星布滿了夜空。

short-sighted.e: I am short-sighted, so I need glasses to read the board.
short-sighted.z: 我近視，所以要戴眼鏡才看得清黑板。

short-term.e: This is only a short-term solution to the problem.
short-term.z: 這只是解決問題的短期辦法。

shortcut.e: We took a shortcut through the park to save time.
shortcut.z: 我們抄捷徑穿過公園來節省時間。

sickness.e: He missed a week of school because of sickness.
sickness.z: 他因為生病缺課了一個星期。

smoky.e: The kitchen became smoky after he burned the toast.
smoky.z: 他把吐司烤焦後，廚房裡煙霧瀰漫。

south-east.e: The typhoon is moving toward the south-east of Taiwan.
south-east.z: 颱風正朝臺灣東南方移動。

south-west.e: Kaohsiung is in the south-west of Taiwan.

specialized.e: This hospital has a specialized team for children.
specialized.z: 這家醫院有一支專門照顧兒童的團隊。

sportsperson.e: She was chosen as the best young sportsperson of the year.
sportsperson.z: 她獲選為年度最佳青年運動員。

staircase.e: The old house has a wide wooden staircase.
staircase.z: 這棟老房子有一座寬大的木造樓梯。

storey.e: Our school library is a three-storey building.
storey.z: 我們學校的圖書館是一棟三層樓的建築。

storyteller.e: The storyteller made the children laugh with funny voices.
storyteller.z: 說故事的人用滑稽的聲音逗得孩子們哈哈大笑。

suffering.e: The volunteers worked hard to reduce the suffering of flood victims.
suffering.z: 志工們努力減輕水災災民的痛苦。

sunbathe.e: Many tourists like to sunbathe on the beaches of Kenting.
sunbathe.z: 許多遊客喜歡在墾丁的海灘做日光浴。

sunlight.e: Plants need sunlight and water to grow.
sunlight.z: 植物需要陽光和水才能生長。

sunrise.e: We got up early to watch the sunrise.

sunset.e: The sky turned orange and pink at sunset.
sunset.z: 夕陽西下時，天空變成橘色和粉紅色。

supporter.e: My mom is my biggest supporter.
supporter.z: 我媽媽是我最大的支持者。

tablecloth.e: She spread a white tablecloth on the dining table.
tablecloth.z: 她在餐桌上鋪了一條白色桌巾。

tack.e: Please tack the poster to the board.
tack.z: 請把海報釘在布告欄上。

teen.e: Every teen should get enough sleep at night.
teen.z: 每個青少年晚上都應該睡飽。

televise.e: The station will televise the baseball game live.
televise.z: 電視臺將現場轉播這場棒球賽。

thinking.e: This activity encourages creative thinking in students.
thinking.z: 這個活動能激發學生的創意思考。

thunderstorm.e: The picnic was canceled because of a thunderstorm.
thunderstorm.z: 野餐因為雷雨而取消了。

toothpaste.e: Don't forget to buy toothpaste on your way home.
toothpaste.z: 回家路上別忘了買牙膏。

training.e: New workers receive two weeks of training.
training.z: 新進員工會接受兩週的訓練。

traveling.e: The traveling circus comes to our town every winter.
traveling.z: 那個巡迴馬戲團每年冬天都會來我們鎮上。

tulip.e: A red tulip opened in our garden this morning.
tulip.z: 今天早上我們花園裡開了一朵紅色鬱金香。

typewriter.e: My grandfather still writes letters on an old typewriter.
typewriter.z: 我爺爺還在用一臺舊打字機寫信。

typist.e: The typist could type eighty words a minute.
typist.z: 那位打字員一分鐘能打八十個字。

understanding.e: A good understanding of math will help you in science.
understanding.z: 把數學學通了，對學自然科學也會有幫助。

underwater.e: We took underwater photos of the colorful fish.
underwater.z: 我們在水下拍了五顏六色的魚。

underweight.e: The baby was a little underweight at birth.
underweight.z: 這個寶寶出生時體重有點不足。

unexpected.e: We had an unexpected visitor last night.
unexpected.z: 昨晚我們家來了一位意外的訪客。

unknown.e: The song was written by an unknown artist.
unknown.z: 這首歌是一位沒沒無聞的歌手寫的。

untouched.e: He left his dinner untouched because he felt sick.
untouched.z: 他覺得不舒服，晚餐一口都沒動。

unusual.e: It is unusual to see snow in Taipei.
unusual.z: 在臺北看到下雪是很不尋常的事。

waltz.e: My grandparents still love to waltz in the living room.
waltz.z: 我爺爺奶奶還是很喜歡在客廳跳華爾茲。

warfare.e: The museum explains how warfare changed over the centuries.
warfare.z: 博物館介紹了戰爭型態幾百年來的演變。

warship.e: An old warship is now a floating museum in the harbor.
warship.z: 一艘舊軍艦現在成了港口裡的水上博物館。

washing.e: Please hang the washing outside to dry.
washing.z: 請把洗好的衣服拿到外面晾乾。

watchman.e: The night watchman checks every door before midnight.
watchman.z: 夜間警衛會在午夜前檢查每一扇門。

well-known.e: This night market is well-known for its stinky tofu.
well-known.z: 這個夜市以臭豆腐聞名。

westerner.e: The westerner learned to use chopsticks very quickly.
westerner.z: 那位西方人很快就學會用筷子。

wildly.e: The fans cheered wildly when the team scored.
wildly.z: 球隊得分時，球迷瘋狂地歡呼。

willow.e: A tall willow grows beside the pond.
willow.z: 池塘邊長著一棵高高的柳樹。

working.e: We need a working title for our school play.
working.z: 我們需要替學校話劇取一個暫定的劇名。

worn.e: My old sneakers are worn and full of holes.
worn.z: 我的舊球鞋已經磨壞了，到處都是破洞。

worthless.e: The old coins turned out to be worthless.
worthless.z: 那些舊硬幣結果一文不值。

wow.e: Her singing will wow the judges.
wow.z: 她的歌聲一定會讓評審驚豔。

wrapping.e: Please recycle the wrapping from your gifts.
wrapping.z: 請把禮物的包裝材料拿去回收。

writing.e: Her writing has improved a lot this year.
writing.z: 她的寫作今年進步很多。

written.e: Please give me a written answer by Friday.
written.z: 請在星期五前給我書面答覆。
